in a throwaway worktree: Claude Code 2.1.303 (`c*`), then Codex CLI 0.163.0
(`x*`). Evidence and method:
`hrn:node:hadronmemory.com:hadron-dev-team-joshua:work:cli907-scratch-terminal-evidence-2026-10-18`.
